# OSC 7: a file URL of this host gives its path; another host and an empty report are ignored
size 80 24
write "\x1b]7;file:///home/u/dev\x07"
expect cwd "/home/u/dev"
write "\x1b]7;file://another-machine/home/u\x07"
expect cwd ""
write "\x1b]7;\x07"
expect cwd ""
write "\x1b]7;file://localhost/tmp\x1b\\"
expect cwd "/tmp"
